specials.name: Fear
specials.description:
This model causes fear.

Fear is a natural reaction to huge or unnerving creatures. A model must take a fear test (ie, test against his Leadership) in the following situations. Note that creatures that cause fear can ignore these tests.

a) If the model is charged by a warrior or a creature which causes fear.

If a warrior is charged by an enemy that he fears then he must take a test to overcome that fear. Test when the charge is declared and is determined to be within range. If the test is passed the model may fight as normal. If it is failed, the model must roll 6s to score hits in that round of combat.

b) If the model wishes to charge a fear-causing enemy.

If a warrior wishes to charge an enemy that it fears then it must take a test to overcome this. If it fails the model may not charge and must remain stationary for the turn. Treat this as a failed charge.

specials.name: Stupidity
specials.description:
Many large and powerful creatures, as well as some of the more unhinged individuals in Mordheim, are unfortunately rather stupid.

Models that are stupid test at the start of their turn to see if they overcome their stupidity. Make a test for each model affected by stupidity. If you pass the test by rolling their Leadership value or less on 2D6 then all is well – the creatures behave reasonably intelligently and the player may move and fight with them as normal.

If the test is failed all is not well. Until the start of his next turn (when it takes a new Stupidity test) the model will not cast spells or fight in hand-to-hand combat (though his opponent will still have to roll to hit him as normal).

If a model who fails a Stupidity test is not in hand-to-hand combat, roll a D6.

D6 | Result
1-3 | The warrior moves directly forward at half speed in a shambling manner. He will not charge an enemy (stop his movement 1" away from any enemy he would have come into contact with). He can fall down from the edge of a sheer drop (see the Falling rules) or hit an obstacle, in which case he stops. The model will not shoot this turn.
4-6 | The warrior stands inactive and drools a bit during this turn. He may do nothing else, as drooling is so demanding.

Regardless of whether the test is passed or failed, the result applies until the start of the model's following turn (when it takes a new Stupidity test).

specials.name: Immune to Psychology
specials.description: Not affected by psychology (such as fear) and never leaves combat.

specials.name: Immune to Poison
specials.description: Not affected by any poison.

specials.name: No Pain
specials.description: The model treats a stunned result on the Injury chart as knocked down.

specials.name: Daemon Soul
specials.description: A Daemon lives within the mutant’s soul. This gives him a 4+ save against the effects of spells or prayers.

specials.name: Great Claw
specials.description: One of the mutant’s arms ends in a great, crab-like claw. He may carry no weapons in this arm, but gains an extra attack in hand-to-hand combat with a +1 Strength bonus.

specials.name: Cloven Hoofs
specials.description: The warrior gains +1 Movement.

specials.name: Tentacle
specials.description: One of the mutant’s arms ends in a tentacle. He may grapple his opponent in close combat to reduce his attacks by -1, down to a minimum of 1. The mutant may decide which attack his opponent loses.

specials.name: Blackblood
specials.description: If the model loses a wound in close combat, anyone in base contact with the model suffers a Strength 3 hit (no critical hits) from the spurting corrosive blood.

specials.name: Spines
specials.description: Any model in base contact with the mutant suffers an automatic Strength 1 hit at the beginning of each close combat phase. Spines will never cause critical hits.

specials.name: Scorpion Tail
specials.description: The mutant has a long barbed tail with a venomed tip, allowing him to make an extra Strength 5 attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase. If the model hit by the tail is immune to poison, the Strength of the hit is reduced to 2.

specials.name: Extra Arm
specials.description: The mutant may use any single-handed weapon in the extra arm, giving him +1 attack when fighting in hand-to-hand combat. Alternatively, he may carry a shield or a buckler in the extra arm. If a Possessed chooses to do this, he gains an extra attack but still cannot carry a weapon.

specials.name: Hideous
specials.description: The model causes fear.

specials.name: Crystalline Body
specials.description: The model's Toughness becomes 6 and its Wounds 1. Neither can be changed afterwards by experience or mutation: an advance that would change either is re-rolled until it gives another characteristic.

specials.name: Hulking Brute
specials.description: The model gains +2 Strength and suffers -4 Leadership.

specials.name: Poisonous Bite
specials.description: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model gains an extra attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase: a poisonous bite at Strength 5, or Strength 2 against a target immune to poison. A bite attack it already has becomes poisonous in this way instead.

specials.name: Prehensile Tail
specials.description: Unless it already has a tail attack, the model gains an extra tail attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase. The tail may hold and use any single-handed weapon, or carry and use a shield or buckler. A model with other tail attacks picks one tail at the start of each hand-to-hand combat, and uses none of the others while it uses an equipped prehensile tail. A model that can't use weapons only gains the extra attack (unless it has a tail already), and still can't use weapons.

specials.name: Scaly Skin
specials.description: Scales give the model a 5+ save. Strength modifiers can't take this save beyond 6, but any 'no save' result on the Critical Hit charts negates it. Light armour adds +1 to the save, as do other armours.

specials.name: Wings
specials.description: The model can't fly, but it can glide down from a raised position: from a roof, walkway, cliff or other platform it moves 2" horizontally for each 1" it moves down.

specials.name: Stream of Corruption
specials.description: The model can spew forth a grotesque stream of maggots, entrails and filth. This is counted as a shooting attack with a range of 6" and is resolved at Strength 3 with no saves for armour.

specials.name: Nurgle's Rot
specials.description: The model is infected with the deadly pestilence of its lord – Nurgle’s Rot. In addition, the model is immune to all poisons. Nurgle’s Rot is a deadly contagion for which there is no known cure. This virulent disease can be passed on in hand-to-hand combat. If the model makes a successful to wound roll of 6 this will result in the target model contracting the Rot (note: Nurgle’s Rot only affects the living, so Undead, Daemons and the Possessed are immune). Once a warrior has contracted the Rot, mark this on the warband roster. Rather than killing the victim immediately, the Rot can take some time to set in. From now on, before the start of each battle, the warrior must pass a Toughness test. If successful, his constitution has managed to stave off the Rot’s effects. If unsuccessful, the warrior loses one point of Toughness permanently (if he reaches zero, he has succumbed to the Rot and died, remove him from the roster). In addition, if a 6 is rolled for the Toughness test then he has unwittingly passed the Rot on to another member of the warband (randomly allocate a warband member and mark this on the roster).

specials.name: Cloud of Flies
specials.description: The model is surrounded by a cloud of flies, which buzz around him and his combat opponent. They do not affect the model but distract foes by buzzing into eyes, nostrils and mouths. The model’s close combat opponent suffers a -1 to hit modifier on all attacks.

specials.name: Bloated Foulness
specials.description: The model is a huge, disgusting mass of diseased, flabby folds. It gains +1 Wound and +1 Toughness but has its Movement reduced by -1.

specials.name: Mark of Nurgle
specials.description: The model is burned with the great mark of Nurgle, the three spheres, that weep foul pus constantly. It gains +1 Wound and is immune to all poisons.

specials.name: Suckers
specials.description: The model automatically passes Initiative tests when climbing.

specials.name: Plague Carrier
specials.description: The model's Movement and Initiative are reduced by 1. Each time it hits an enemy in hand-to-hand combat, the enemy must roll its Toughness or less on a D6, or suffer -1 Movement and -1 Initiative for the rest of the battle (it recovers after the battle). It may infect each model only once in a battle.

specials.name: Beak
specials.description: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model makes an extra bite attack in each close combat phase, at its own Strength and with no penalty for not using a weapon. The bite always strikes last, whoever charged and whatever weapon is used, even after double-handed weapons.

specials.name: Burning Body (Tchar)
specials.description: The model may carry no weapons or armour unless they are magical or of Gromril or Ithilmar. It suffers none of the usual penalties for fighting with its fists, and always counts as having a lantern. At the end of every turn, roll a D6 for each model in base contact with it: on a 4+ that model is set on fire (Border Town Burning, page 70).

specials.name: Electrical Touch
specials.description: The model may give up one of its close combat attacks to jolt an enemy model instead, resolved at +1 Initiative: an automatic Strength 3 hit that ignores all armour saves, or Strength 5 against an enemy wearing any metal armour. After a jolt it takes D3 turns to build another charge.

specials.name: Eye of Tchar
specials.description: Instead of attacking in close combat, the model may try to transfix a living model in base contact that isn't immune to psychology: the victim must pass a Leadership test or be transfixed. A transfixed model may not attack in close combat and counts as knocked down for being attacked. It must pass a Leadership test at the start of each later combat phase, or stays transfixed.

specials.name: Mer-creature
specials.description: The model is aquatic. It can be submerged in water without harm, treats impassable obstacles such as deep rivers, lakes or open sea as difficult terrain, and ignores the penalties for slow-moving rivers and ponds that count as difficult terrain. On land its Movement is reduced by 1.

specials.name: Telekinesis
specials.description: Only a spell caster may have this. In the shooting phase, instead of casting a spell, the model may lift a loose object within 6" with a successful Leadership test (at -3 if the object is taller than 1") and move it anywhere within 6" of itself. A weapon lifted so can be fired in the shooting phase, or used to attack an enemy model in the hand-to-hand combat phase. Once put down, an object needs another successful test to move it or another; the object must be put down before the model casts a spell. This isn't a spell.

specials.name: Centauroid
specials.description: The model's legs become the four legs and body of a beast the size of a small horse: +2 Movement and +1 Toughness.

specials.name: Iron-hard Skin
specials.description: The model's armour save improves by +1. With no armour, its skin alone gives it a 6+ save.

specials.name: Fangs (Arkhar)
specials.description: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model makes an extra bite attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase, at its own Strength and with no penalty for not using a weapon. The bite always strikes last, whoever charged and whatever weapon is used, even after double-handed weapons.

specials.name: Spiked Tail
specials.description: Unless it already has a tail, the model gains an extra tail attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase, at its Strength +1. A model that already has a tail decides at the start of each hand-to-hand combat which tail it uses.

specials.name: Regeneration
specials.description: When the model suffers one or more wounds, it may try to regenerate: on a D6 roll of 4+ it heals back to its full Wounds at once. On a lower roll its regeneration is spent, and it may not try again for the rest of the battle.

specials.name: Spit Acid
specials.description: In the shooting phase the model may spit acid at a target up to 8" away: a Strength 4 shooting attack with no penalty for range or for moving.

specials.name: Atrophy
specials.description: Part of the model withers. Roll a D6. 1, the head: it is subject to stupidity. 2-4, an arm: it loses the use of one arm and may use only a single one-handed weapon from now on; with both arms lost it is retired from the warband unless it has a tail or bite attack. 5-6, a leg: its Movement is halved, rounding up; with both legs lost it is retired from the warband.

specials.name: Beaked
specials.description: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model makes an extra bite attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase.

specials.name: Beweaponed Extremities
specials.description: The model's hands become weapons: roll a D6 for each arm, 1-2 a sword, 3-4 a mace, 5-6 an axe. It may no longer use weapons or equipment that need hands. It gains the usual extra attack for an additional hand weapon, and each follows the rules for a weapon of its type (a sword may parry); with two swords it re-rolls failed parries as with a sword and buckler.

specials.name: Brightly Patterned Skin
specials.description: Bright stripes, spots or other patterns on the model's skin. No effect on play.

specials.name: Burning Body
specials.description: The model may carry no weapons or armour unless they are magical or of Gromril or Ithilmar. It suffers none of the usual penalties for fighting with its fists (no -1 Strength, and enemies get no +1 to their armour saves), and always counts as having a lantern. Every model in base contact with it suffers an automatic Strength 2 hit at the start of each close combat phase; the flames never cause critical hits.

specials.name: Elastic Limbs
specials.description: If the model isn't in base contact with an enemy at the start of the hand-to-hand combat phase, it may make one hand-to-hand attack against a single visible enemy within 6". That enemy can't strike back.

specials.name: Enormously Fat
specials.description: The model's Movement is halved, rounding up; it gains +1 Toughness and suffers -1 Initiative.

specials.name: Extremely Thin
specials.description: The model's Toughness is halved, rounding up.

specials.name: Fangs
specials.description: Unless it already has a bite attack, the model makes an extra bite attack at its normal Strength in each hand-to-hand combat phase.

specials.name: Furry
specials.description: Long, dense fur covers the model. No effect on its profile.

specials.name: Horns
specials.description: The model gains an extra gore attack in hand-to-hand combat at its normal Strength, and may no longer wear a helmet.

specials.name: Plague Bearer
specials.description: The model's Movement and Initiative are reduced by 1. Each time it hits an enemy in hand-to-hand combat, the enemy must roll its Toughness or less on a D6, or suffer -1 Movement and -1 Initiative for the rest of the battle (it recovers after the battle). It may infect each model only once in a battle. It also causes fear.

specials.name: Resilient
specials.description: The model gains +1 Toughness.

specials.name: Stunted
specials.description: The model's Movement and Initiative are reduced by 1.

specials.name: Warts
specials.description: Repellent warts cover the model. Its profile is unaffected.
